title: Protein extraction from aortas or VSMCs for Western blot
author: Muthi Ikawati
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.nxadfie

steps.title: Prepare Samples
steps.instruction: Prepare either aorta tissue or VSMCs for extraction.

substeps.instruction: For aortas: Thaw frozen aorta in a 37°C waterbath, mince on ice, and pool aortas from 3-4 mice in a single microtube.
For VSMCs: Wash cells with phosphate-buffered saline (PBS) three times and aspirate the PBS thoroughly.

steps.title: Prepare SMAD Lysis Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare a lysis buffer containing the following components: 10 mM Tris-HCl pH 7.6, 1% Triton X-100, 100 mM NaCl, 2 mM EDTA, 10% v/v glycerol, 50 mM NaF, 20 mM Na4P2O7, 2 mM Na3VO4, and 1x protease inhibitor cocktail (Nacalai Tesque).

steps.title: Lyse Samples
steps.instruction: Add lysis buffer to the prepared samples and perform mechanical lysis.

substeps.instruction: Add 100 μl lysis buffer for each microtube of pooled minced aortas (approximately 30 mg tissue) or 150 μl lysis buffer for each 35 mm dish of VSMCs.
For aortas: Use a homogenizer followed by a sonicator to further lyse the tissue.
For VSMCs: Use a sonicator to process samples.

steps.title: Clarify Lysate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the lysed samples to separate the supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 15,000 x g for 10 min at 4°C.
Transfer the resulting supernatant into a new microtube.

steps.title: Measure Protein Concentration
steps.instruction: Quantify protein levels using the Pierce 660nm Protein Assay Reagent (Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #22660).

substeps.instruction: Create a BSA standard curve to plot absorbance into concentration values.

steps.title: Prepare Samples for Loading
steps.instruction: Denature the proteins for Western blot analysis.

substeps.instruction: Add 5x SDS loading dye to the samples.

steps.title: Store Samples
steps.instruction: Store the prepared protein samples at -20ºC until use.
